title: Missing moeb tool: Edit (README patch fallback)
description: Used Claude Code Edit tool to insert a row into .moeb/README.md after patch_file failed repeatedly. No moeb equivalent exists for a reliable line-insert that bypasses patch_file when its context-matching fails on large files with long lines.
proposed_resolution: Investigate and fix patch_file context-matching on Windows CRLF files (see companion Critical signal). Alternatively, introduce a write_file_insert_after tool that locates a unique anchor string and appends a line after it, bypassing unified diff parsing entirely.
